continuity_scope: Cartoon Network's original Adventure Time television-series continuity only, bounded to the first aired season-one pair: "Slumber Party Panic" and "Trouble in Lumpy Space." This pass uses exact official Apple TV episode metadata as the episode locator and Cartoon Network Japan's official series page for basic character terminology; it does not merge the earlier pilot, comics, games, Distant Lands, Fionna and Cake, later episodes, or later lore.
work_or_witnesses: Adventure Time, Season 1 Episode 1: Slumber Party Panic, official Apple TV episode listing
Adventure Time, Season 1 Episode 2: Trouble in Lumpy Space, official Apple TV episode listing
Cartoon Network Japan official Adventure Time programme page
coverage_rule: Include individually named dramatic characters directly named in the two selected episode descriptions: Finn, Jake, and Princess Bubblegum. Lumpy Space is an unpersonalized place/category in the E2 title and description, while zombies, candy/kingdom categories, magic, transformations, places, artifacts, post-apocalyptic readings, and episode mechanics remain terms or omissions rather than character nodes.
omissions: All persons not named in the selected E1–E2 descriptions are outside this tightly bounded opening-pair pass, even if named on the broader official series page.
The pre-series pilot, later original-series episodes, comics, games, Distant Lands, Fionna and Cake, and all other derivative/adaptive continuities are excluded.
The E1 description calls the problem "zombie" but does not establish its cause, rules, casualties, or graphic violence; no detailed violence claim is made.

No post-apocalyptic history, romance, disability, identity development, broader family structure, or body-transformation meaning is inferred beyond the explicitly stated E2 risk that Jake may become permanently Lumpy.
uncertainties: The exact episode descriptions are licensed-platform metadata rather than a full episode transcript; claims are deliberately limited to their wording.

Cartoon Network Japan's page describes Finn as a 12-year-old boy, Jake as his close friend and a dog with special powers, and Ooo as a fantastical land; this page is used for basic source terminology, not to import later plot claims.
"Lumpy" is retained as the episode's fictional transformation state and not interpreted as a diagnosis, disability category, body type, or real-world identity.
evidence_basis: Official Cartoon Network programme material plus exact official Apple TV licensed episode listings. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, recap, unofficial transcript, franchise database, or adaptation source is used.
